messages:
alex_k: kicking off the 2405 release. main change is ff:reorder-heuristic + small routing tweak. planning to pin service to v2.14.0 during the rollout. deploy window 02:00-03:30 UTC.
emma_p: noted. what is the FF plan? can we do a very small canary first? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy queued by alex_k for service=ingress-router tag=v2.14.0 environment=prod. ETA ~5m. See https://redwood.internal/releases/2405 for notes.
samir_r: +1 on tiny canary. suggest 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m with hold windows at each step. auto-rollback if 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline or latency p95 > 20% increase.
marta_ops: ok to proceed with that schedule but we need a manual hold at 25% for 10m — ops will watch error budgets. also pin routing-model to commit sha: a1b2c3d so traffic split won't float.
ajex_k: (typo) -> alex_k: confirming pin to a1b2c3d. adding ff ramp plan to release notes now.
emma_p: can we also push a monitoring eval set? jyoti_ml can you attach the perf prompts?
jyoti_ml: uploaded quick eval in the release page under "smoke-evals". running on canary cohort now. results should show in ~7m.
samir_r: ops checklist: 1) burn-in two canaries 2) confirm KV cache warm 3) enable ff-reorder-heuristic at 0.5% via toggle service 4) watch 5xx/latency + token cost delta

snippet: 
```json
{"rollout": [{"pct":0.5, "hold":"5m"}, {"pct":5, "hold":"10m"}, {"pct":25, "hold":"10m"}, {"pct":50, "hold":"end"}], "rollback_triggers": {"5xx_ratio": 1.5, "p95_latency_increase": 1.2}}
```

marta_ops: deploy-bot will post status. if we see spike at any hold, we manually flip ff to off and start drain.
deploy-bot: canary started: cohort=canary-A pct=0.5%. logs: ingress-router[v2.14.0] starting on gpu-node-17.
emma_p: seeing a small 1.1x bump in p95 on canary-A (not alarming). jyoti any qualitative issues?
jyoti_ml: smoke evals look ok, a couple short token-length regressions in edge prompts but within tolerance.
alex_k: proceed to 5% in 6m unless ops calls hold. I posted release notes summary and linked AD in the top comment: https://redwood.internal/releases/2405/notes
marta_ops: advancing to 5% now. tagging @oncall for extra eyes. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout step completed: pct=5%. next hold=10m.
samir_r: monitoring looks green for now. setting a slack alert if 5xx > 0.8% or p95 > 12% above baseline.
emma_p: quick reminder — feature flag name is `ff.reorder_heuristic.v2` (use the toggle service or console). do not change any other routing flags during window.
alex_k: if we reach 25% and metrics stable we'll leave at 50% for remainder of the window and cherry-pick the release notes into next changelog. if anything spikes we roll back and pin to v2.13.9.
marta_ops: copy. preparing rollback runbook entry and drain steps.
jenkins-bot: deploy job finished: all steps green. artifacts: ingress-router:v2.14.0 (sha a1b2c3d).

deploy-bot: final note: if rollback triggered, please include `rollback_reason` tag and the earliest failing timestamp when filing postmortem.
emma_p: thanks everyone. keeping this thread live during the window. ping here if any holds or rollbacks. :rocket:
